description.line1: Stored in account_meta.account_business_type_info. (user_id, business_type) is the account's unique key; multiple channels under the same account_type are distinguished by different business_type values.
description.line2: To add a channel, please use the channel registration flow on the "System Account" page; this page is for query / audit only.
description.line3: Convention: 1-9 system preset, 10-100 reserved, 101-999 custom channels.

alert.description: Once created, a business_type cannot have its category / account_type changed (which affects debit/credit direction). To disable a channel, use the admin API PUT enabled=0.

createModal.title: Add Business Type (registry only, no accounts created)
createModal.alertDescription: This action only writes a row into account_meta.account_business_type_info; no accounts are created. After registration, go to the "System Account" page and select this business_type to trigger Fleet creation of 100 sharded accounts.

form.businessTypeTooltip: 0 = auto-assign an unused number from [101, 999]; you may also specify manually

messages.registered: Registered: business_type={{businessType}} · {{code}}. Next, go to the "System Account" page to create 100 sharded accounts.
